brief.t: START HERE: Open the 5 kg NatureInBottle sea buckthorn seed oil order with Evelyn and confirm it matches her production request.

ACT NOW 1: Sea buckthorn: confirm the existing order and arrival. Michael and Evelyn have waited 1 day for 3.2 kg more to continue production. NatureInBottle order 1793377149822 already covers 5 kg seed oil; a $283.32 PayPal payment notice exists. Dispatch, arrival, project linkage and QC release remain unverified. Talova #49 instead lists berry/fruit oil; do not substitute or place a duplicate order. Send internally: Evelyn and Michael, please match the 5 kg seed oil order to your request and confirm the project, specification and latest usable-arrival date today before we buy anything else.

ACT NOW 2: Talova: verify what actually finished yesterday. Michael's October 30 meeting assigns Tolova Phase B and production-area cleaning to Evelyn. Trial, sanitation, completed quantity and QC release remain unverified. CRM #49 has an October 14 expected completion date, 17 days past, and no recorded finished output; this does not prove nothing was made. Confirm the exact project/batch before linking the meeting to #49. Send internally: Ron and Evelyn, please send yesterday's Talova batch results, cleaning sign-off and finished quantity, then have Michael confirm today's remaining owner and handoff.

ACT NOW 3: Oreka: close Nadia's delivery loop today. Nadia's response task is 17 days overdue. Her Canada window ends tomorrow, November 1. CRM still shows sample batching; no verified finished-sample QC release or delivery. Mibelle raw-material tracking is not finished-sample shipment proof. Send internally: Michael and Steve, please confirm Oreka's finished samples and delivery status today; if Canada is no longer feasible, give me the revised destination and date for Nadia.
